name: Mixamo body + ARKit/Oculus face (experimental)
about: For characters rigged with Mixamo (bones named mixamorig:Hips, mixamorig:Spine, ...) whose face has ARKit blendshapes (jawOpen, mouthFunnel, ...) and Oculus visemes (viseme_FF, ...). The build strips the mixamorig: prefix and renames the visemes to the names the engine uses, in its own copy of your file. Extra jiggle bones are off (their positions depend on the character); set extra_bones to add them.
